content.title: Astrology
content.text: Astrology Astrology Counselling Connecting your soul life on earth with the night sky Astrology offers a diverse perspective about who we are, the life experiences we have, and the relationships we are drawn to in our life. We are complex beings and astrology offers a way to be with the complexity within ourselves and the night sky. An individual birth chart astrology consultation (reading) and astrology counselling sessions offer curiosity and meaningful awareness in areas such as: self-awareness, identity, inner psychology, relationships, health, work and career, family, spirituality, making meaning around transitions and important life passages or experiences, life purpose or direction, dreams, aspirations, and soul longings.The birth chart is the heavenly sky under which you were born, and it contains all the meaningful symbolism of the 12 ‘creatures’ in the zodiac, the planets, and other celestial bodies such as minor planets and asteroids. During an astrology consultation a creative space is provided for the stories and symbols in the sky to meet you in your present felt-experience. Individual Birth Chart Astrology Consultation An introduction to astrology and your birth chart. Ideal if you have not had a birth chart reading before and are new to astrology. If you’d like to book a birth chart consultation (reading). You can book online by clicking the button below. You will receive a confirmation email upon booking and a form to complete with your birth details.75 mins - $140 Book Individual birth CHART Consultation Astrology CounsellingAstrology counselling sessions focus on offering a creative and reflective space for you to share what is relevant in your life. These sessions are ideal if you have had an initial birth chart reading and are seeking support to navigate things such as: life transitions, to support inner connection with your soul, to understand more your psychology, to deeply feel the archetypes and astrology shaping your life, to explore astrological transits, and anything else you might be personally working through in your life. 60 mins - $110 BOOK ASTROLOGICAL COUNSELLING SESSION Urania - Muse of Astronomy and Astrology in Greek Myth Wikimedia Creative Commons Conditions for bookingAn Individual Birth Chart Astrology Consultation and Astrology Counselling sessions are available in-person, in Tauranga. After you have made a booking you will receive a confirmation email with request for your full name, the exact location, date and time of your birth. If there is anything you are particularly interested in exploring you can let me know. We’ll meet for the consultation and explore your birth chart. You will receive your birth chart so you can revisit it anytime.Please note: Individual Birth Chart Astrology Consultation and Astrology Counselling sessions are only available if you are requesting this appointment for yourself and have made an informed decision that this is something you are wanting for yourself. I do not offer relationship astrology consultations for couples, and I do not offer astrology consultations as gifts for others without their informed choice. Astrological StyleMy astrological approach is a blending of traditional Helenestic-Greek astrology with myth and archetypal astrology. I understand astrology as an art-form and symbolic language particularly useful for study of the self and exploration into: our birth into the world and the relationships we have with our self and others, our present life challenges, our ancestral or inter-generational trauma, our collective traumas and the impulses of destiny and fate in our life. My particular interest is in weaving together astrological wisdom with our birth stories to help the healing process of difficult or traumatic birth experiences, and to support greater awareness of the impacts of our birth experience on our present life.
